items.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server.

items.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions.

items.title: Amazon Acquires DuckLabs and Integrates DuckDB in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
items.blurb: Amazon has acquired DuckLabs, the company behind the analytical database DuckDB. Co-founders Hannes Mühleisen and Mark Raasveldt will continue to lead the team under AWS.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: Beam model by Reflection is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart and AWS Trainium
items.blurb: Beam, the first open weight model offered by US-based Reflection, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, the model hub in Amazon SageMaker AI.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions.

items.title: AWS Transform announces Azure-to-AWS cloud-native code conversion
items.blurb: Today, AWS announced the general availability of application code conversion from Azure SDK to AWS SDK in AWS Transform, giving you an accelerated path to migrate Microsoft Azure cloud-native .NET applications to AWS.

items.title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now supported in the AWS Mexico (Central) Region
items.blurb: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks are now supported in the AWS Mexico (Central) Region.
